title: Codex Channel Index
description: Pointer and quick eligibility summary for a single channel (alpha|beta|stable). Points at the full update-manifest.json. Does NOT duplicate manifest fields (AV-SCH-4).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this channel-index contract. Bump on any field-list or cross-field-rule change (per F1 closure schema-version discipline).

channel.description: The single channel this index file describes. One channel per file.

version.description: Release version string for the artifact pointed at by this channel index.

tag.description: Release tag, prefixed by the channel. Must satisfy cross-field rule tag.split('/')[0] == channel.

release_url.description: Canonical URL to the release page or release notes for the artifact referenced by this index.

manifest_url.description: URL to the update-manifest.json for this release. Must end with .json (AV-SCH-8, schema-side half).

publication_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp marking when this index was published.

tranche_id.description: Identifier of the tranche that produced this release. Locked to STC-CODEX-SD-16 for the duration of this contract.

signature.description: Reserved signature field. Cryptographic signing is deferred for Tranche 2.5 (AV-SCH-3); null is accepted, a populated object is reserved for a future contract bump.

allOf.description: Cross-field rule: tag prefix must equal channel (F1 closure §Channel index contract).
